dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: You wanna know when Boss is getting back? Sorry, I have no idea.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: What I do know is that the boss and Shinobu both see this festival as a major event, so they hope to get as many people to come as possible. That's why they're out there working hard to promote it.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: They said this will improve the image of the Arataki Gang, but I wouldn't know anything about that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Still, I think he'll be back to see you before it's over.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: After all, he respects you a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Are you ready for your Drumalong performance?
